name: block_card
description: You can call block_card to freeze a card, but only after the customer confirms.

name: get_branch_hours
description: You can call get_branch_hours to read the opening hours of a branch.

name: get_dispute_status
description: You can call get_dispute_status to read where a dispute stands.

name: list_transactions
description: You can call list_transactions to read recent activity on an account.

name: lookup_balance
description: You can call lookup_balance to read the available balance of an account the customer has verified.

name: open_dispute
description: You can call open_dispute to start a dispute, but only after the customer confirms the transaction.

name: send_payment
description: You can call send_payment to make a payment, but only after the customer confirms the amount and the payee.

name: update_address
description: You can call update_address to change the mailing address, but only after the customer has been verified.
